Figure 1:Overview ofMILO, a meta-evolutionary harness discovery framework.Given an agent,MILOdiscovers a stronger harness for its model via two coupled loops: an inner loop that evolves harnesses
and an outer loop that evolves the search strategy. In the inner loop, (1) a parent is drawn
from the island’s admitted candidates, (2) itsmutator agentrewrites the whole harness from the
parent’s failure traces and the island’slineage memory, including rejected candidates, and (3–4) the child is
scored and admitted on multi-objective Pareto gain. (5) When progress stalls, the outer loop’sorchestrator
agentdiagnoses the island and revises its mutator, memory, and curriculum.
Figure 2:General skeleton for evolutionary search.Tab.classifies existing methods by adaptiveness.
